'''Tyl Krain''' was a male [[Human/Legends|human]] cam operator for the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Madhi Vaandt]]. He was blond-haired and considered to be good-looking by Mahdi. During the [[Octusi]] uprising on [[Blaudu Sextus]], he caught [[Belok Rhal]] and his fellow [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] massacring thousands of Octusi on camera. This caused Rhal to attack the reporters. In the assault, Tyl filmed Mahdi's murder at the hands of Rhal, as well as his subsequent rescue by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]].

The images were sent out live over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] and threatened to spark revolts all throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
